verses.1: And we went to the land beyond the sea, to the land of the Gerasian people.
verses.2: And as soon as he got off the ship, a man in a corrupted state of spirit was brought before him from among the memorials.
verses.3: He who lived in those tombs; no one was able to hold him anymore.
verses.4: Because it could be torn apart by many threads and ropes. Its threads and ropes would get scattered everywhere. No one could ever tear it apart.
verses.5: And throughout the nights and days, in the tombs and on the mountains, they would shout and throw stones at themselves.
verses.6: And when they saw Jesus from a distance, they rushed forward and bowed down to him.
verses.7: And he cried out with a loud voice, “What is my fate and yours, Jesus, son of the Most High? I swear by God that you will not torture me.”
verses.8: For he said to him, “Let the unclean spirit depart from man.”
verses.9: And he asked him, “What is your name?” And he replied, “My name is Levan.”
verses.10: And he also asked many things so that he wouldn’t have to send them out of the country.
verses.11: And there was a large herd of sheep grazing near the mountain.
verses.12: And they called out to him, saying, “Let us go into the sheeppen, so that we can enter there.”
verses.13: And he allowed them to go. Then, the unclean spirits entered into the fish. And the angel rushed towards the sea, in pairs, and they drowned in the sea.
verses.14: And the boasters fled from them, and went to the city and to the fields. They came to see what had happened.
verses.15: And they came to Jesus. They saw the man who was being possessed, sitting there, covered in blood, and acting in a strange manner. They were terrified.
verses.16: And those who were there told them how the possessed man became like that, and about the pigs as well.
verses.17: And they began to ask him to leave from those hills.
verses.18: And when he entered the ship, the demonist called out to him, asking to go with him.
verses.19: And he did not abandon him. Instead, he said to him, “Go back to your home and tell your friends about everything that your Lord has done for you and praised you for.”
verses.20: And he went away and began to proclaim in the Decapolis all that Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.
verses.21: And after Jesus passed by on the ship, once again a large crowd rushed towards him, and they were near the sea.
verses.22: And one of the leaders came forward, named Iairos. When he saw that water was falling on his feet,
verses.23: And he pleads with him, saying many things, that my daughter has no other choice but to come and kiss his hands, so that she can be saved and live.
verses.24: And I went away with him. A large crowd followed him, and they all hated him.
verses.25: And a woman who lived in a place covered with blood for twelve years.
verses.26: And she suffered greatly under the care of many doctors. She spent all her money on them, yet she received no compensation at all. Instead, she became even more destitute.
verses.27: I heard about Jesus. As I walked among the crowd, someone took off his coat from behind him.
verses.28: He said that if I managed to get free from his grasp, even then I would still be trapped.
verses.29: And soon, the source of her blood dried up. Her body realized that she was suffering from inflammation.
verses.30: And immediately, Jesus recognized in himself the power that came from him. As he returned to the crowd, he said, “Who has touched my clothes?”
verses.31: And his disciples said to him, “Do you see how the crowd is upset with you? And you say, ‘Who has done this to me?’”
verses.32: And it was clear that this was what they had done.
verses.33: And the woman, being afraid and trembling, knew what had happened to her. So she came forward and told him all the truth.
verses.34: And he said to her, “Daughter, your faith has saved you. Go in peace, and be healthy again.”
verses.35: While he was still speaking, people from the school’s administration came forward and said that your daughter had died. Why do you still want to keep this teacher around?
verses.36: But when Jesus heard his words, he said to the leader of the crowd, “Do not be afraid; simply believe.”
verses.37: And no one else was willing to follow him, except for Peter, James, and John, the brothers of James.
verses.38: And they come into the house of the chief priest. They see a lot of noise, crying, and screaming.
verses.39: And when he entered, he said to them, “Why are you making noise and crying? The child has not died; he is still alive.”
verses.40: And he also laughed at him. But when he brought everyone out, he took the child’s father, mother, and those who were with them along with him. Then he went to find out where the child was.
verses.41: And he held the child’s hand in his own. He said to her, “Talitha cum!” This means “Behold, it is born.” The hair on the child’s head became thick. I say, it became thicker.
verses.42: And soon, the crown was placed on his head, and he became king. He was indeed twelve years old at that time. They immediately set him on a high throne.
verses.43: And he also gave them many things, so that no one would know about this. He said that they should be given food to eat.
